title_zh: Anna Freud 的校本 CBT 計畫 MindWorks 進入 30 間學校做 RCT
title_en: Anna Freud's MindWorks school CBT programme enters RCT
summary_zh: MindWorks 是 Anna Freud 開發、以系統取向為基礎的 CBT 計畫，對象為 11–16 歲學生，由受訓的教育心理健康從業員等在一個學期內提供，並把家長與學校職員納入。計畫由 Youth Endowment Fund 資助，2026 年 9 月起在英格蘭 30 間主流與另類學校推行，Ending Youth Violence Lab 以 720 名兒童進行隨機對照試驗。
summary_en: MindWorks, a systemic CBT programme for 11–16-year-olds developed by Anna Freud, launches in 30 English schools from September 2026 and is being evaluated in an RCT of 720 children by the Ending Youth Violence Lab.
evidence_note: 計畫推行公告；RCT 仍在進行，尚無結果。文中「平均減少 72%」引自國際文獻而非本計畫。

ethics_flags.note: 校本介入涉及學生、家長與學校職員三方，資訊分享需有清楚界線。

caution: 目前只有計畫描述，成效要等 RCT 結果；文中 72% 數字不是本計畫的結果。

posts.title: Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT) programme developed by Anna Freud to launch in schools
posts.content: Anna Freud 開發的系統取向 CBT 計畫 MindWorks 於 2026 年 9 月起在英格蘭 30 間學校推行，對象 11–16 歲，由 Ending Youth Violence Lab 以 720 名兒童進行隨機對照試驗評估。

related.title_zh: 青少年「失眠」可能是晝夜節律延遲：挪威研究近九成有相位後移指標
related.summary_zh: ACAMH 部落格整理挪威 3,867 名高中生的研究（Arnesen 等，2025）：34.5% 符合失眠標準，但其中 88.4% 呈現晝夜節律延遲的指標。作者建議評估上學日與假日的睡眠時間差、延後就寢是否改善入睡、週末補眠等；失眠以 CBT-I 處理，節律延遲則考慮光照、褪黑激素時機與逐步提前起床時間，而非只叫孩子早點上床。
related.summary_en: An ACAMH blog summarises a study of 3,867 Norwegian high-school students (Arnesen et al., 2025): 34.5% met insomnia criteria, yet 88.4% of these showed indicators of circadian delay. The author recommends assessing school-day vs free-day sleep timing, response to later bedtimes and weekend catch-up sleep; CBT-I for insomnia, and light, melatonin timing and gradual wake-time advances for circadian delay rather than simply earlier bedtimes.

related.title_zh: 青少年自傷：把每次接觸服務變成照護機會——英國 544 名自殺身亡青少年資料
related.title_en: Youth self-harm and service contact before suicide
related.summary_zh: ACAMH 部落格評介英國全國連續案例系列研究（Aggarwal 等，British Journal of Psychiatry, 2025）：544 名 10–19 歲自殺身亡者中 49% 有自傷紀錄、26% 有近期自傷；近期自傷者中 60% 在死亡前三個月內曾接觸心理健康服務，95% 經歷近期逆境。另有 51% 沒有自傷紀錄。作者建議評估不只看自傷行為，也要看關係、安全與環境壓力，並提供協調的個別化照護與 48 小時內的後續追蹤。
related.summary_en: An ACAMH blog reviews a UK consecutive case series (Aggarwal et al., British Journal of Psychiatry, 2025) of 544 young people aged 10–19 who died by suicide: 49% had a self-harm history and 26% recent self-harm; among those with recent self-harm, 60% had contact with mental health services in the prior three months and 95% had recent adversity, while 51% had no recorded self-harm. The author urges broader assessment of relationships, safety and stressors, coordinated care and 48-hour follow-up.

related.title_zh: 英國 16 歲以下社交媒體禁令：教師與神經多樣性顧問的兩種看法
related.title_en: UK under-16 social media ban: two professional perspectives
related.summary_zh: 英國政府於 2026 年 6 月宣布，明年起禁止 16 歲以下使用 YouTube、Instagram 等多個社交平台（WhatsApp、Signal 除外）。教師顧問 Andrew Apraku 以校內網絡欺凌、深偽圖像、睡眠不足等問題支持禁令；自閉症顧問 Ann Memmott 則指出社交媒體是孤立、殘障與神經多樣青少年的重要連結，並引用澳洲經驗指約七成年輕人在數月內找到繞過方法。
related.summary_en: Anna Freud presents two professional views on the UK's planned under-16 social media ban: a teacher who supports it citing cyberbullying and deepfakes, and a neurodiversity consultant who warns it may cut off isolated and neurodivergent youth.
